name: CommercialDentalNoAuthRule
title: Commercial Dental PPO — D7210 / D6010 Require No Prior Authorization

action.title: Confirm no PA required for D7210 / D6010; benefits active
action.description: When a D7210 or D6010 order is signed for a covered party of this commercial dental PPO, return an informational CDS card confirming no prior authorization is required and benefits are active — no DTR launch, no PAS submission. This is the negative-result CRD path (contrast UC02a, whose action launches DTR).
